description: Compare each team's home-game total with the average number of games in an individual home_game record.

b.request: Rank the 10 teams with the highest ratio of their cumulative home games to the average games value across all individual home_game records, displaying each team's total home games, its proportion of all home games, and the ratio, sorted descending by ratio with missing values last.
b.sql: SELECT hg.team_id, SUM(hg.games) as total_home_games, SUM(hg.games) / (SELECT SUM(games) FROM home_game WHERE games IS NOT NULL) as proportion_of_all_home_games, SUM(hg.games) / (SELECT AVG(games) FROM home_game WHERE games IS NOT NULL) as ratio FROM home_game hg WHERE hg.games IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hg.team_id ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
b.raw: Rank the 10 teams with the highest ratio of their cumulative home games to the average games value across all individual home_game records, displaying each team's total home games, its proportion of all home games, and the ratio, sorted descending by ratio with missing values last.

a.request: For each team (`team_id`) in `home_game`, add up its home `games`, ignoring missing values. Return the team id, that total, the total as a fraction of the sum over all teams, and the total divided by the average `games` value of a single `home_game` record. Sort by that last ratio from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round.
a.sql: SELECT team_id, SUM(games) as total_games, SUM(games) / (SELECT SUM(games) FROM home_game WHERE games IS NOT NULL) as fraction_of_total, SUM(games) / (SELECT AVG(games) FROM home_game WHERE games IS NOT NULL) as ratio_to_avg FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

c.request: Which 10 teams have the most home games relative to the average? For each team id, give its total home games (ignoring missing values), its share of all home games, and its total divided by the average number of home games. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest (missing last) and don't round. Compare each team's home-game total with the average number of games in an individual home_game record.
c.sql:
WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    SUM(games) as total_home_games
  FROM home_game
  WHERE games IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY team_id
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(games) as avg_games_per_record,
    SUM(games) as total_all_games
  FROM home_game
  WHERE games IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ts.team_id,
  ts.total_home_games,
  ts.total_home_games / os.total_all_games as share_of_all_games,
  ts.total_home_games / os.avg_games_per_record as ratio_to_average
FROM team_stats ts
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

d.request: For each of the top 10 teams by total home games (sum of games column), report the team's total home games, its share of all home games across all records, and its total home games divided by the average games value per individual home_game record.
d.sql: WITH team_games AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) as total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id), overall_stats AS (SELECT SUM(games) as total_all_games, AVG(games) as avg_games_per_record FROM home_game), top_10_teams AS (SELECT team_id, total_games FROM team_games ORDER BY total_games DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT t.team_id, t.total_games, (t.total_games / os.total_all_games) as share_of_all_games, (t.total_games / os.avg_games_per_record) as ratio_to_avg FROM top_10_teams t CROSS JOIN overall_stats os ORDER BY t.total_games DESC
